lessons.title: Parts of a Plant
lessons.content:
# Parts of a Plant

## Main Parts

### 1. Roots 🌱
- Grow underground
- Absorb water and minerals
- Anchor the plant

### 2. Stem 🌿
- Supports the plant
- Transports water and food
- Holds leaves and flowers

### 3. Leaves 🍃
- Make food (photosynthesis)
- Breathe (exchange gases)
- Green due to chlorophyll

### 4. Flowers 🌸
- Reproductive part
- Produce fruits and seeds
- Attract pollinators

### 5. Fruits 🍎
- Protect seeds
- Help in seed dispersal

## Fun Fact
The largest flower is Rafflesia - 3 feet wide!

**Plants are amazing!** 🌿

lessons.title: Animals Classification
lessons.content:
# Animals Classification

## Types of Animals

### 1. Mammals 🐄
- Give birth to babies
- Feed milk to young
- Have hair or fur
- Examples: Cow, Dog, Human

### 2. Birds 🐦
- Have feathers and wings
- Lay eggs
- Have beaks
- Examples: Eagle, Sparrow, Penguin

### 3. Reptiles 🦎
- Cold-blooded
- Lay eggs
- Have scales
- Examples: Snake, Lizard, Crocodile

### 4. Amphibians 🐸
- Live on land and water
- Lay eggs in water
- Examples: Frog, Salamander

### 5. Fish 🐟
- Live in water
- Have gills to breathe
- Examples: Shark, Goldfish

**Nature is diverse!** 🌍

lessons.title: Human Body Systems
lessons.content:
# Human Body Systems

## Major Systems

### 1. Digestive System 🍔
- Breaks down food
- Absorbs nutrients
- Organs: Stomach, Intestines

### 2. Respiratory System 🫁
- Helps us breathe
- Takes in oxygen
- Organs: Lungs, Nose

### 3. Circulatory System ❤️
- Pumps blood
- Transports oxygen
- Organs: Heart, Blood vessels

### 4. Nervous System 🧠
- Controls body
- Sends signals
- Organs: Brain, Nerves

## Fun Fact
Your heart beats 100,000 times per day!

**Your body is incredible!** 💪
